title: 10-Year Treasury Note auction (December reopening) — the one coupon leg that prices while the FOMC is in session, ~25 hours before the 12-09 dot-plot decision
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), re-fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes), FlateDecode streams inflated PER PAGE and rows rebuilt from Tm coordinates independently of the proposal that discovered this event. The page-3 row reads verbatim `10-Year NOTE / R / Thursday, December 03, 2026 / Tuesday, December 08, 2026 / Tuesday, December 15, 2026`; the same page carries the legend `R --denotes reopening`, so this sells more of an existing security. 1:00pm ET is Treasury standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-12-03 coupon announcement. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-09 by this event own never-assessed initial research, which read `proposals/treasury-10y-note-2026-12-08.from-treasury-3y-note-2026-12-07.json` (the only proposal for this id) in full first per EVENT-RESEARCH.md. The date, the reopening read and the 12-15 settlement all reproduce against a fresh page-by-page fetch of the same primary. SIX AMENDMENTS to what the proposal carried. (1) THE SIZE IS $39B, NOT $42B — the single material correction. The proposal put expected size at $42B, `the standing 10-Year size`. $42B is the NEW-ISSUE size; this is a REOPENING, which the proposal itself says two sentences earlier. `auctions_query` pulled 2026-09-09 (318 rows, 103 of them 10-Year TIPS returned as `security_type: Note` and dropped on a non-null `ref_cpi_on_issue_date`, leaving 215 nominal) shows 21 consecutive $39B reopenings from 2024-03-12 through today 2026-09-09, of which 20 have cleared: bid-to-cover mean 2.555, sigma 0.089, range 2.34-2.70, clearing yields 3.648% -> 4.680%. 2026-12-08 would be the 23rd, with 2026-09-09 the 21st and 2026-10-07 (also `R` on the schedule) the 22nd in between. (2) THE AUCTION IS NOT AT D-1 OF THE MEETING; IT IS ON DAY ONE OF IT. federalreserve.gov fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200), lists the December 2026 meeting as `December 8-9*` — a TWO-DAY meeting whose first session is this auction day, with the `*` marking a Summary of Economic Projections. The 1:00pm ET stop prints while the Committee is in session, roughly 25 hours before a dot-plot decision (`fomc-2026-12-09`, confirmed, `FED:`). That is a sharper statement of the proposal structural point, not a contradiction of it. (3) 2026-12-09 IS THE EARLIEST DECEMBER FOMC DECISION IN THE 2009-2026 RECORD. Harvesting scheduled decision dates from fomchistorical<YEAR>.htm (2009-2020) and fomccalendars.htm (2021-2026) gives exactly 8 per year for all 18 years. The December decision has landed on day 16, 14, 13, 12, 18, 17, 16, 14, 13, 19, 11, 16, 15, 14, 13, 18 and 10 — day 9 is a new low. That, not the auction, is what compresses the gap to one day. (4) THE NATURAL EXPERIMENT THE PROPOSAL NAMED HAS ALREADY BEEN RUN, AND RETURNS A NULL ON DEMAND. Signed days from each of the 214 cleared nominal 10-Year auctions to the nearest scheduled decision: 6 have auctioned at D-1 (2012-09-12, 2019-12-10, 2020-06-09, 2024-06-11, 2025-05-06, 2025-12-09 — all six on day one of a two-day meeting, five of the six SEP meetings), 9 at D-2, 4 on decision day itself. Against each one four nearest auctions with no FOMC within 5 days, the D-1 cohort bid-to-cover delta is -0.025 (3/6 above its own control) and the pooled D-2/D-1 cohort -0.016 (7/15). The 2025-12-09 analogue — same month, same $39B, same FOMC-eve slot — cleared 2.550 against the era mean 2.555. (5) THE DECEMBER 10-YEAR HAS NEVER AUCTIONED AFTER THE DECEMBER DECISION. All 17 December 10-Year auctions since 2009 were reopenings (17/17) and all 17 sat at or before the decision — 15 at D-1 or earlier, 2 on decision day, 0 after. The proposal `three legs straddle the meeting at three different distances` is true of the block but not of this leg historically: only the 30-Year (12-10) prices post-decision. (6) THE NEW-ISSUE SOMA ADD-ON DOES NOT TRANSFER TO A FIRST REOPENING — the number a reader carrying the November sibling ledger is most likely to get wrong by ~$11B. Splitting nominal 10-Year auctions by cycle position since 2018: NEW issues took a positive SOMA add-on 35/35, mean $12.35B, accepted/offering 1.346x; FIRST reopenings (Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec) 16/35 positive, mean $0.85B, 1.023x; SECOND reopenings (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct) 27/35, mean $2.70B. On the $39B era the first-reopening add-on is mean $0.33B, max $1.26B, and 2025-12-09 took exactly zero. December is a first reopening: expect a line near $39B, not near $50B. WHAT IT REOPENS: the 2026-11-10 new issue, on the lineage every December reopening since 2020 follows (dated 11-15, maturing 10 years later on 11-15, first coupon the following 05-15, term `9-Year 11-Month`). NO CUSIP IS PREDICTED — the November new issue own CUSIP does not exist yet. THE SESSION IS NOT THE ONLY SUPPLY EVENT, unlike the November leg: a 6-Week BILL also auctions 2026-12-08, and 17-/4-/8-week bills are announced the same day. CORRIDOR: 28 tracked entries within +/-5 days, six of them high — ISM Services 12-03 and jobs 12-04 land before the auction; FOMC 12-09, CPI 12-10 and the government-funding deadline / CR expiry 12-11 all land after it and inside the 12-15 settlement window. DISCOVERED IN-SWEEP AND PROPOSED IN THIS PR: `treasury-10y-note-2027-01-12`, this security next reopening. NAMED AND DELIBERATELY NOT FILED so a sibling can: the January 2027 3-Year (01-11), 30-Year (01-13) and the 2027-01-07 coupon announcement. Reading it, not trading it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed.
